title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
description:
Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) für unseren Business Development-Bereich, die Prozesse mit modernen Tools gestalten und automatisieren und dafür sorgen, dass Systeme ineinandergreifen, Datenflüsse reibungslos funktionieren und unsere Abläufe noch effizienter werden.
 Du hast Erfahrung mit digitalen Themen und kennst dich mit Low-Code-/No-Code-Lösungen sowie API-Tools wie Zapier oder Make.com aus oder bist in der Lage, dich schnell und eigenständig einzuarbeiten? Dann ist unser Bereich IT bzw. Business Development die richtige Wahl für Dich.
 Dich erwartet bei Hohn Digital ein moderner und schnell wachsender Arbeitgeber , bei dem Du in einem leistungsorientierten und kollegialen Team arbeitest.
 Dein Aufgabenbereich: Automatisierung unserer Geschäftsprozesse mit No-Code / Low-Code Tools wie n8n, Zapier, Make
 Aufbau, Pflege und Verwaltung von Airtable-Datenbanken
 Entwicklung von Front-Ends und Interfaces mit No-Code / Low-Code-Tools
 Management und Weiterentwicklung unseres CRM-Systems (insbesondere Close)
 Planung, Umsetzung und Implementierung von neuen Geschäftsprozessen
 Dokumentation & Konzeption von digitalen Geschäftsprozessen
 Anwenderschulung & -betreuung
 Grundgehalt Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: 4.000€ - 6.000€ brutto monatlich je nach Erfahrung
 Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.
 Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.
Diese Vorteile erwarten Dich bei Hohn Digital:
 Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Du erhältst von Beginn an ein Grundgehalt über dem Branchendurchschnitt.
 Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir unterstützen Dich mit Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten, unserem digitalen Schulungssystem und regelmäßigen Feedback-Gesprächen, sodass Du Dich stetig weiterentwickeln kannst und Deine Fähigkeiten verbesserst.
 Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Die Einarbeitung erfolgt strukturiert, mit klaren Prozessen und gibt Dir Sicherheit. Mit unserem digitalen Schulungssystem…

title: Senior Merchant Success Manager
description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will... 

  • Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place. 
  • Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

title: Regional Sales Director- UK
description:
Forward Networks is transforming how the world’s most complex networks are managed and secured. Founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, we built the industry’s first network digital twin — a mathematically precise model of the production network that gives IT teams unmatched visibility, verification, and agility across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Our customers include global leaders such as Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell, as well as fast-growing enterprises and government agencies. According to IDC, Forward Networks customers realize an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits through improved efficiency and security.

Backed by world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, and Threshold Ventures, Forward Networks offers a people-centric, innovative culture where brilliant minds are shaping the future of network reliability, security, and AI-ready operations.

Forward Networks is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Director UK

Do you want to create a category and help build a special company?
Do you want to sell a platform that solves real networking problems?
Do sensible quotas and no cap on earnings pique your interest?
Join a company that has been in the market 6+ years and has some of the top F500/Global 2000 and Federal agencies already buying and referenceable.

If you have 7-10 years of wildly successful experience selling to large enterprises and have also been on the journey of building a growth stage company...you may be the one!
We are building a special team and hope you consider us if you want to be part of changing the networking world as we know it. 

Responsibilities

title: Senior People Partner - 12m FTC
description:
Senior People Partner - 12m FTC

London (Vauxhall)

Hybrid 2-3days per week

£79,000-85,000

The Role

ClearScore is looking for an experienced People Partner to join our People team on a maternity cover basis. This is a hands-on role in a fast paced environment, with responsibility across employee relations, performance, organisational change and People development.

You’ll inherit live casework and ongoing initiatives from day one, working closely with managers and People colleagues to provide practical, commercially-minded advice and deliver meaningful People initiatives across the business.

We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running, is confident operating independently and enjoys balancing day-to-day People partnership with longer-term projects.

An interest in AI and how it can be applied practically within People would be a bonus.

 

 

What you will be doing:

Employee Relations & People Partnering

  • Own and manage end-to-end employee relations work, including absence management, underperformance, behavioural concerns, disciplinary and grievance processes.
  • Coach and support managers through complex and difficult conversations, ensuring they have the confidence and tools to manage People matters effectively.
  • Provide pragmatic, balanced advice that considers both employee experience and business needs.
  • Ensure People processes are applied consistently, fairly and appropriately.

Performance Management
